articles.summary: REalloys today today announced that a subsidiary of REalloys and the U.S. Department of the Army ("Army") have executed a non-binding term sheet setting out the principal commercial terms for a potential Enhanced Use Lease ("EUL") to develop a heavy rare earth processing facility at Tooele Army Depot in Utah.
articles.title: REalloys and U.S. Army Execute Term Sheet for Heavy Rare Earth Processing Facility at Tooele Army Depot
